# Granite 4.0 1B Speech

IBM · released 2026-03 · 2.31B params · apache-2.0

**score 63.8** ±2.6 · #7 of 110 · from 2 benchmark results across 2 sources · \* thinly tested, treat the rank as provisional

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

<pre>
version               needs  score
bf16 · nvidia only  ~6.04GB   63.8
bf16 · mac only     ~6.04GB   63.8
</pre>

```sh
# bf16 · nvidia only
vllm serve ibm-granite/granite-4.0-1b-speech --max-model-len 2048
# bf16 · mac only
uvx --from mlx-audio mlx_audio.stt.generate --model ibm-granite/granite-4.0-1b-speech --audio audio.wav --output-path transcript
```

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>
